proof_summary: The recurrence is converted into a formula for each prime-adic valuation; for \(p\ne3\), expanding valuations as counts of divisibility by \(p^j\) and comparing the corresponding residue classes modulo \(p^j\) shows that the three numerator progressions dominate the denominator progression and two factorial contributions. For \(p=3\), the progression terms are all prime to 3 and \(2v_3(n!)<n\), so every prime-adic valuation is nonnegative and the rational coefficient is integral.
